jtag_enumeration.interpretation: JTAG返回xc7z020和IDCODE 23727093；与Z-020系列/密度相符，但属性不含封装、速度等级或温度等级，不能据此确认完整订货型号。

tcl_commands.name: connect_and_enumerate_targets
tcl_commands.result: hw_server localhost:3121 connected; one Digilent target 210512180081 enumerated.

tcl_commands.name: open_target_and_read_device_properties
tcl_commands.command: set ts [get_hw_targets]; puts "TARGET_COUNT=[llength $ts]"; foreach t $ts {puts "TARGET=$t"}; set t [lindex $ts 0]; if {$t eq ""} {error "NO_TARGET"}; if {[catch {open_hw_target $t} e]} {error "OPEN_TARGET_FAILED:$e"}; set ds [get_hw_devices]; puts "DEVICE_COUNT=[llength $ds]"; foreach d $ds {puts "DEVICE=$d"; foreach p {NAME PART IDCODE JTAG_INDEX IS_PROGRAMMABLE} {if {[catch {set v [get_property $p $d]}]} {set v "<unavailable>"}; puts "$p=$v"}}
tcl_commands.result: Two devices enumerated: arm_dap_0 and xc7z020_1.

tcl_commands.name: list_available_device_properties
tcl_commands.result: Available property list contains PART, VARIANT_NAME, IDCODE, IDCODE_HEX and IR_LENGTH; no package/speed/temperature-grade property was exposed. Full list is preserved in vivado_hw_readonly.log.

tcl_commands.name: read_full_device_identity_properties
tcl_commands.command: set d [get_hw_devices xc7z020_1]; foreach p {NAME PART VARIANT_NAME IDCODE IDCODE_HEX IR_LENGTH UNKNOWN_DEVICE} {puts "$p=[get_property $p $d]"}
tcl_commands.result: NAME=xc7z020_1; PART=xc7z020; VARIANT_NAME=; IDCODE_HEX=23727093; IR_LENGTH=6; UNKNOWN_DEVICE=0.
